articles.title: As big bitcoin miners chase AI profits, individuals get another shot at the rewards
articles.snippet: Several companies offer access to bitcoin mining without the hassle of running equipment, but high costs and the 2028 reward halving make profits uncertain.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether and XRP selloff wipes out $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto bets
articles.snippet: Bets on rising prices accounted for nearly 84% of forced closures, with Binance handling almost half the total. A rebound has since started catching short sellers.

articles.title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
articles.snippet: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

articles.title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
articles.snippet: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.

articles.title: Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3B Binance hack
articles.snippet: Circle, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks fell sharply Friday, a day after Binance disclosed a $6.3 billion security breach.
